title: salix saxatilis subsp. stoloniferoides
intro: Salix saxatilis subsp. stoloniferoides, commonly known as Willow, is a subspecies of the willow plant that is known for its stoloniferous growth habit. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Salix saxatilis subsp. stoloniferoides include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and vasodilatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, salicylic acid, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its therapeutic actions and are used to create medicinal products that promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being.
